sample_unit: BraTS 2020 MRI slices/cases (number not reported in available text)

links.outcome: Unsafe false acceptance rate of segmentation with uncertainty-based deferral to radiologist versus baseline
links.effect: Safety gate reduced Unsafe False Acceptance Rate from 5.1% to 0.2% versus AdaMM; deferring the 30% most uncertain pixels raised retained accuracy (from 68.8%, text truncated).
links.quote: On BraTS 2020, Fail-SafeAI achieves a whole-tumor Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 0.864 under complete data and ≥0.795 under single-modality dropout, outperforming AdaMM by 7.2 percentage points under missing T1ce while reducing the Unsafe False Acceptance Rate from 5.1% to 0.2%.

unlisted_practices: Evidential deep learning uncertainty (vacuity) with a learnable safety gate to accept, escalate, or inpaint missing MRI modalities
Training with per-channel modality dropout for robustness to missing MRI sequences

screen.reason: Evaluates an evidential uncertainty-based safety gate that triggers escalation to a radiologist or image synthesis under missing MRI modalities, testing rejection/deferral thresholds to reduce unsafe false acceptances.

primary.practice: safety-gated uncertainty thresholding with human escalation
